snippets.name: laminate-button
snippets.css: body[data-sty="memphis"] .btn-cook { background: #ffe34f; color: #171326; border: 3px solid #171326; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 #fa5f8a; padding: 0.7em 1.2em; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }
snippets.why: Bright laminate colors, black outlines and offset geometric depth echo Memphis furniture.

snippets.name: confetti-frame
snippets.css: body[data-sty="memphis"] .sty-tex.tex-memphis-1 { background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, #171326 0 3px, #ffdc55 3px 12px), repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, #171326 0 3px, #ffdc55 3px 12px), repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, #171326 0 3px, #56d5cb 3px 12px), repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, #171326 0 3px, #56d5cb 3px 12px); background-position: top, bottom, left, right; background-size: 100% 12px, 100% 12px, 12px 100%, 12px 100%; background-repeat: no-repeat; }
snippets.why: Striped contrasting edges recall Memphis patterning while leaving the center unpainted.

snippets.name: playful-tilt
snippets.css: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { @keyframes memphis-tilt-1 { 0%, 100% { transform: rotate(-3deg); } 50% { transform: rotate(3deg); } } body[data-sty="memphis"] .anim-memphis-1 { animation: memphis-tilt-1 4s ease-in-out infinite; } }
snippets.why: A gentle wobble suggests the movement's playful, off-kilter geometry.

snippets.name: triangle-disc
snippets.css: body[data-sty="memphis"] .orn-memphis-1 { display: inline-block; width: 64px; height: 58px; position: relative; background: #fa5f8a; clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); } body[data-sty="memphis"] .orn-memphis-1::after { content: ""; position: absolute; width: 18px; height: 18px; left: 23px; top: 30px; border-radius: 50%; background: #171326; }
snippets.why: A pink triangle and black dot evoke the movement's bold, simple geometric ornaments.
